title: Morning Topic Brief smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Morning Topic Brief craftbook: two watched topics come from a live fake feed service (eight items, one duplicate of yesterday, one single-sourced rumor), and the dated brief lands in briefs/ with sources cited and the rumor flagged.
prompt: morning — can you pull the feeds and write todays breif? its july 16 so it goes in briefs/2026-07-16.md next to yesterdays. the fake feed service is wired up with a probe script

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for morning-brief. The feeds are wired as a live fake service — endpoints in mocks/services.md, and the ready-made mock-probe project script fetches every watched topic's items. Watched topics are seeded at topics.json and yesterday's brief sits in briefs/; today's brief goes to briefs/2026-07-16.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Morning Topic Brief craftbook/template, pull the current items for each topic in topics.json from the fake feed service through the provided probe, and write briefs/2026-07-16.md. No real feeds, services, or credentials — only the wired mock.

files.content:
# Morning brief - 2026-07-15

## Municipal Broadband
- Council delays the broadband vote to August, citing the unfinished cost study. (Newsline - https://newsline.example/broadband/vote-delay)
- Westport's pilot posts its first uptime report: 99.2% over 90 days. (Capitol Wire - https://capitolwire.example/fiber/westport-uptime)

## Battery Recycling
- County adds two weekend drop-off depots after the spring pilot. (Harbor Bulletin - https://harborbulletin.example/recycling/depots-added)

mocks.description: Fake feed service for this eval. GET /feeds/municipal-broadband and GET /feeds/battery-recycling each return the topic's current items with title, source, url, and confidence notes.

items.title: Council pushes broadband vote to August
State grant window opens for municipal fiber pilots
County said to be in talks to sell its dark fiber
What the pilot towns learned in year one
Weekend depots triple battery drop-off volume
Recycler expands second-life pack line at the port
Fire-code update targets battery storage depots
Study puts LFP recovery rates at 91 percent

mocks.description: Provenance-trusted project script `mock-probe` that fetches every watched topic's current items from the fake feed service through http.authed.

success.summary: briefs/2026-07-16.md is a five-minute brief grounded in the live fake feeds: a section per topic, sources cited per item, the dark-fiber rumor flagged as unconfirmed, and yesterday's council-vote story not re-reported as new.

checks.label: a section for the broadband topic
a section for the recycling topic
the single-sourced dark-fiber item is flagged, not reported as fact
the fresh grant-window story from the live feed is in the brief
the fresh depot-volume story from the live feed is in the brief

checks.rubric: Yesterday's council-vote delay story is skipped or explicitly marked as already covered rather than re-reported as new, and the single-sourced dark-fiber item is flagged as rumor or unconfirmed, not presented as settled reporting.
checks.label: dedupe and skepticism

axes.name: selection
axes.description: The kept items are the ones worth the owner's morning; duplicates of yesterday and noise are cut, with nothing important missing.

axes.name: sourcing
axes.description: Every item names its source, linked where the feed gave one.

axes.name: skepticism
axes.description: Single-sourced material is flagged as rumor or unconfirmed and kept visually separate from reporting.

axes.name: brevity
axes.description: Five minutes of reading — tight sentences, no filler, sections that scan.

qualityFocus: rumor flagged, never dressed as fact
